safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated covers denial of nausea/vomiting, but does not mention 'no unwell contacts'; therefore the full Gold fact is not present.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “no unwell contacts” has limited diagnostic or management impact in an adult with presumed viral URI symptoms, since treatment and safety-netting typically depend more on symptom severity and risk factors than on exposure history. This is primarily a completeness/documentation issue with minimal downstream clinical consequence.
